UpdateSourceArgs: -c "cd openggf-multi && if [[ -x java/bin/java ]]; then Installed=$(java/bin/java --version | grep 'Temurin-' | head -n1 | sed -n 's/.*Temurin-\([^[:space:]]\+\).*/\1/p'); else Installed=''; fi; Latest=$(wget -qO- 'https://api.adoptium.net/v3/assets/latest/25/hotspot?architecture=x64&image_type=jre&os=linux&vendor=eclipse' | jq -r '.[0].version.openjdk_version' | sed 's/-LTS$//'); if [[ -n \"$Latest\" && \"$Installed\" == \"$Latest\" ]]; then echo \"Eclipse Temurin JRE $Latest already installed\"; exit 0; fi; rm -f java.tar.gz; wget -qO java.tar.gz https://api.adoptium.net/v3/binary/latest/25/ga/linux/x64/jre/hotspot/normal/eclipse || { echo 'Temurin download failed'; exit 1; }; rm -rf java && mkdir -p java && tar -xzf java.tar.gz -C java --strip-components=1 && rm -f java.tar.gz && java/bin/java --version | head -n1"
